## PRODUCT OVERVIEW

|-------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|----------|--------------|
| Acid Chlorides                | Trifluoroacetyl chloride                                   | TFAC     | 354-32-5     |

| Alkanes                       | 1,1-Dichloro-2,2,2-trifluoroethane (SOLKANE@ 123)          | S123     | 306-83-2     |

| Anhydrides                    | Trifluoroacetic acid anhydride                             | TFAH     | 407-25-0     |
|                               | Trifluoromethanesulfonic anhydride                         | TAA      | 358-23-6     |
| Esters and Acetoacetates      | Difluoroacetic acid ethyl ester                            | DFAEt    | 454-31-9     |

|                               | Trifluoroacetic acid isopropyl ester                       | TFAiP    | 400-38-4     |
|                               | Trifluoroacetic acid methyl ester                          | TFAMe    | 431-47-0     |
| Ketones                       | 4-Ethoxy-1,1,1-trifluoro-3-buten-2-one                     | ETFBO    | 59938-06-6   |
|                               | 1,1,1-Trifluoroacetone                                     | TFK      | 421-50-1     |
| Heterocycles                  | 3-(difluoromethyl)-1-methyl-IH-pyrazole-4-carboxylate      | DFMPA    | 176969-34-9  |
|                               | 1-Methyl-3-(trifluoromethyl)-IH-pyrazole-4-carboxylic acid | TFMPA    | 113100-53-1  |
| Solvents for Li-lon batteries | Monofluoroethylene Carbonate                               | FIEC     | 114435-02-8  |
